methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched and verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15 for Postman (postman.com/pricing), Kong (konghq.com/pricing), Apigee (cloud.google.com/apigee/pricing, corroborated against official Google Cloud pay-as-you-go docs), Tyk (tyk.io/pricing), Zuplo (zuplo.com/pricing), Stoplight (stoplight.io/pricing), Gravitee (gravitee.io/pricing), and Treblle (treblle.com/pricing — now reachable live). Treblle was rebuilt: the live official page shows only Core ($233/mo billed yearly), Growth (custom), and Enterprise (custom) — NO free tier and NO $25 Starter tier; the draft's Free and Starter plans were fabricated from stale Capterra/GetApp aggregator data and have been removed. Kong Konnect Plus overage corrected to the official $200/million-requests figure (the aggregator's $34.25 contradicts the live page). Zuplo's dead pricingsaas.com corroboration (404) was removed. MuleSoft and RapidAPI Enterprise Hub remain excluded (blocked, unverifiable). For quote-only/contact-sales plans, monthlyUsd is null. Prices in USD. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Postman
vendors.provenance: Fetched postman.com/pricing live 2026-06-15; Free $0, Solo $9 (annual), Team $19/user (annual only), Enterprise $49/user (annual only) all confirmed. Annual-only billing for Team/Enterprise corroborated via apidog.com/blog/postman-pricing-2026/ (live).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, 50 AI credits/month, API client and core tools, specs and mock servers, native Git, collection runner.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: 1 user, $9/mo billed annually (up to 25% savings vs monthly). 400 AI credits/month, data-driven testing, unlimited private NPM packages, custom-branded docs, unlimited custom domains.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $19/user/month billed annually only; requires annual commitment. 400 AI credits/user/month, basic RBAC, SDK generation and distribution, unlimited workspace viewers.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $49/user/month billed annually only; requires annual commitment. API Catalog, private API Network, advanced RBAC, governance, audit logs, 800 AI credits/user/month (pooled).

limits: Free plan: 1 user only, 50 AI credits/month
keyFeatures: API client with built-in testing and mock servers
AI-assisted API design and documentation generation
Private API Network and catalog (Enterprise)
SDK generation and distribution
enrichment.provenance: Plan names and prices fetched live from postman.com/pricing; annual-only billing requirement for Team/Enterprise confirmed via apidog.com/blog/postman-pricing-2026/.

vendors.name: Kong Konnect
vendors.provenance: Fetched konghq.com/pricing live 2026-06-15; covers Kong Konnect gateway plans and Insomnia API client plans. Konnect Plus $105/service/month confirmed; overage corrected to official $200/million requests (max 10M/month) — supersedes the aggregator's $34.25 figure.

plans.name: Free Trial
plans.notes: 30-day free trial of full enterprise functionality; no credit card required. Includes unlimited gateways and 30-day analytics retention.

plans.name: Konnect Plus
plans.notes: $105/service/month (per gateway service), billed monthly. Includes 1M API requests/month; additional requests $200/month per 1M (max 10M/month). Up to 5 Serverless Gateways, 2 Hybrid Gateways, 2 Dedicated Cloud Gateways, 2 developer portals, service catalog for 2 services. Email support, 2-business-day SLA.

plans.name: Kong Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual billing. Unlimited gateways and developer portals, unlimited services catalog, SSO, audit logging, dedicated success manager, higher SLAs.

plans.name: Insomnia Essentials
plans.notes: API client free tier. Git Sync up to 3 users, unlimited cloud/local projects, CLI access, 1,000 mock server requests/month.

plans.name: Insomnia Pro
plans.notes: $12/user/month; 15% discount with annual billing. Unlimited users, RBAC, Git Sync for all, 10,000 mock server requests/month.

plans.name: Insomnia Enterprise
plans.notes: $45/user/month, self-serve up to 50 users. Kong Konnect integration, SSO, SCIM, unlimited mock requests, enterprise support.

limits: Konnect Plus: priced per gateway service; 1M requests/month included per service, overage $200/million (max 10M/month)
Insomnia Essentials: Git Sync capped at 3 users, 1,000 mock requests/month
keyFeatures: Multi-protocol gateway (REST, gRPC, Kafka, WebSockets, GraphQL)
AI gateway capabilities
Service catalog and developer portal
Open-source Kong Gateway core (Apache 2.0)

vendors.name: Apigee (Google Cloud)
vendors.provenance: cloud.google.com/apigee/pricing fetched live (truncated on render) and cross-verified against official Google Cloud pay-as-you-go docs: hourly rates $0.5/$2.0/$4.7 x ~730h = $365/$1,460/$3,431 per month per region. 60-day Evaluation trial confirmed.

plans.name: Evaluation
plans.notes: 60-day free sandbox trial; no upfront commitment. Shared environment with limited throughput for prototyping and evaluation only.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go — Base
plans.notes: $365/month per region (≈$0.50/hour), plus API call charges. Up to 20 API proxies per environment, 50 QPS, standard proxy only, 99% SLA. Standard-proxy calls billed at 1/5 of extensible-proxy calls.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go — Intermediate
plans.notes: $1,460/month per region (≈$2.00/hour), plus API call charges. Up to 50 API proxies/shared flows, 100 QPS, supports standard and extensible proxies.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go — Comprehensive
plans.notes: $3,431/month per region (≈$4.70/hour), plus API call charges. Up to 100 proxies/shared flows, autoscaled QPS, up to 85 environments per project, 99.9%–99.99% SLA.

plans.name: Subscription
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual commitment, contact sales. Committed-capacity tiers (Standard/Enterprise/Enterprise Plus), higher SLAs, extended analytics retention.

limits: Pricing is per-region — multi-region costs multiply
keyFeatures: Pay-per-region environment model (hourly billed)
Full-lifecycle API management with advanced analytics
Hybrid and multi-cloud deployment (Apigee hybrid)
Google Cloud security and compliance (HIPAA eligible)
enrichment.provenance: Pay-as-you-go monthly prices ($365/$1,460/$3,431 per region) confirmed via official Google Cloud pay-as-you-go documentation (hourly $0.5/$2.0/$4.7 x ~730h).
